title: Evaluation-induced derived Hom comparison for the etale-proetale morphism
statement: For a scheme $T$, let $A$ be a coefficient abelian Grothendieck category in the common size convention, equipped with the symmetric closed preadditive monoidal structure and functorial flat resolutions used by the existing derived tensor and internal Hom constructions. Assume the canonical comparison inverse image $F=\nu_T^*$ preserves flat sheaves. This includes $A=\mathrm{Mod}(\Lambda)$ for any finite commutative ring $\Lambda$. For arbitrary derived objects $K,M$ on the etale site define the canonical evaluation comparison $F_D R\mathcal Hom(K,M)\to R\mathcal Hom(F_DK,F_DM)$ as the tensor--Hom adjoint of the inverse canonical derived tensor comparison followed by $F_D$ of evaluation. Here $F_D$ is termwise derived comparison pullback; the canonical derived tensor comparison is transported along $LF\cong F_D$ from the K-flat representative comparison. This specializes to the finite constant coefficient sheaves in lem-sf-hom-comparison-finite-free. No isomorphism assertion or Tor condition on $K$ or $M$ is part of the definition. The sites and fixed-module specialization are [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the derived categories and internal Hom are [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], with [def-weil-size-convention]. The comparison inverse image is [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], its exactness is [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact], and its canonical tensor comparison is [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-pullback-tensor].
